en.name: PinboardShot
en.label: Native macOS app
en.headline: Keep inspiration in sight.
en.description: Capture, annotate, extract text, and pin screenshots. A native macOS tool that keeps information from your screen close at hand.

zh.name: PinboardShot
zh.label: macOS 原生应用
zh.headline: 把灵感，贴在眼前。
zh.description: 截图、标注、OCR、贴屏。原生 macOS 工具，让屏幕上的信息成为随手可用的参考。

en.name: Saylit
en.label: Writing studio
en.headline: Your words. Beautifully arranged.
en.description: Write in Markdown, preview your article layout in real time, and copy it into WeChat. Give good content room to flow.

zh.name: 简言 Saylit
zh.label: 写作工作台
zh.headline: 专注表达，其余交给排版。
zh.description: 用 Markdown 写作，实时预览文章版式，一键复制到公众号。让好内容，流动起来。

en.name: Daymark
en.label: Calendar subscriptions
en.headline: Know the days that matter.
en.description: Bring Chinese holidays, solar terms, and adjusted-workday reminders into Apple Calendar. Subscribe once and stay in step with the year.

zh.name: Daymark
zh.label: 日历订阅服务
zh.headline: 重要的日子，提前知道。
zh.description: 将中国节假日、二十四节气与调休提醒带进 Apple 日历。一次订阅，跟上日子的节奏。

en.name: History Sweep
en.label: Chrome extension
en.headline: Clear history. Keep what matters.
en.description: Find browsing history by website, keyword, or date, then review and clear selected records. Search and processing stay on your device.

zh.name: History Sweep
zh.label: Chrome 扩展
zh.headline: 清理历史，留下你想留下的。
zh.description: 按网站、关键词和日期查找浏览记录，审阅后批量清理。搜索与处理都在本机完成。

en.name: Page QR
en.label: Chrome extension
en.headline: From this screen to the next.
en.description: Turn a webpage or custom text into a QR code. Adjust colors and size, then export PNG or SVG. Works offline, too.

zh.name: 页码 Page QR
zh.label: Chrome 扩展
zh.headline: 从这个屏幕，到下一个屏幕。
zh.description: 把当前网页或自定义文字生成二维码，调整配色与尺寸，导出 PNG 或 SVG。离线也能使用。
